data.name: Hubie
data.gender_notes: Hubie is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A short form of Hubert, derived from the German name HUOTBERHT, composed of the elements HUOT (bright, glorious) and BERHT (bright, famous, brilliant, radiant, illustrious). The name Hubie carries the meaning “Friend, Comrade” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Hubie usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, comrade and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hubie is a name that symbolizes the spirit of friendship, faith, and companionship. It represents the bond of love, trust, and loyalty between individuals. It is a name for those who value the relationships they have and strive to maintain them.
data.etymology: Hubie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Comrade.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hubie total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
